verdict.rationale: Cursor documents Privacy Mode (no training on code) and enterprise data governance including subprocessor disclosure and encrypted temporary storage for Cloud Agents, plus service-account key revocation with audit trails. However, there is no documented self-service data deletion/export mechanism, no explicit retention period policy, and no user-facing control to delete stored chat/agent history or account data. missing for 10: explicit data retention periods, user-initiated deletion/export workflow, documentation of how long stored data persists before deletion, non-enterprise (individual user) retention controls.
